title: Injectivity of the counter-loop redirect
statement: Let $S$ be a type with decidable equality, choose a state $a \in S$, and choose an optional exit state. The map sending each $s \in S$ to the decrement-running state when $s=a$, to the escape state when the chosen exit equals $s$, and otherwise to the body state carrying $s$, is injective.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a type with decidable equality
